# Nomad Excel

> Nomad Excel is an entrepreneurship bootcamp platform offering immersive programs in global destinations for aspiring founders and digital nomads seeking to launch and scale ventures.

Nomad Excel combines entrepreneurship education with experiential learning through multi-week bootcamps held in locations like Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Panama, and Bulgaria. The platform emphasizes community-driven growth, mentorship, and practical frameworks like SMART goals, OKRs, and Lean Startup methodologies to help entrepreneurs succeed.

## Key Topics

- Entrepreneurship bootcamp
